Refitting of shaft No. 2:
See drawing No. 41-31767.
The shafts are positioned in their respective openings in the gearbox (bearing housings not fitted
yet). Right hand shaft (seen facing gearbox front) is taken through the rear side, the left through the
front. The gearwheel is well supported against the wall in the gearbox by means of wooden blocks.
The shaft is pressed into the gearwheel hub by means of six extraction bolts, as seen on drawing No.
41-31767.
The wheel is locked on the shaft by the stopper (item 81) which is well secured.
Gearwheel and shaft are displaced axially, until the wheel is close to the wall, where it is supported
by means of wooden blocks.
One of the shaft journals is now sticking out of the gearbox and is accessible for mounting of
bearings. When the bearing housing with snap ring (items 9 and 43) has been fitted to the gearbox,
the bearing with tapered sleeve and end washer (items 35, 37 and 19) can be fitted to the shaft
journal, When fitting bearings, the instructions must be closely followed. See section about mounting
of roller bearings.
The shaft inclusive the gearwheel and bearing is now guided axially inwards until the outer race of
bearing trust against the snap ring in the bearing housing.
The bearing in the other end of the shaft is fitted and then the corresponding bearing housing.
Finally the bearing covers (item 10) are fitted. For both shafts No. 2 the same procedure of assembly
is followed.
Remember fiber gaskets for bearing covers and housings.
Repositioning of input shaft:
The input shaft (item 25) including fitted bearing (item 36) is guided into the gearbox through the
opening in the front wall.
The bearing housing and bearing in the rear wall is mounted as described for shaft No. 2.
Bearing housing in the front wall is fitted.
When the bearing cover has been put on, ensure that the oil seal (item 46) is not damaged.
